# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparison and rendering refinements**

## Highlights

The upcoming SkiaSharp 4.159.0 release adds experimental image comparison tools and refines texture-edge rendering. SkiaSharp.Testing provides configurable image acceptance policies and visual difference diagnostics. Ganesh texture sampling and Tizen CPU blur selection change, and Linux x86 native assets are being dropped.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged** — Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries are removed. Move Linux deployments off x86 before upgrading to this release. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing adds SKImageComparison for images, bitmaps and pixmaps, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and five difference-image styles. Opt in to experimental diagnostic SKIA4001 through NoWarn or a pragma. Results retain no native handles; callers own returned difference images. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer filtered texture-subset edges** — Ganesh clamps linear texture sampling slightly inward to avoid reading undefined texels outside subset boundaries. Texture-edge pixels may differ; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected by this sampling change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur configuration takes effect** — Tizen now uses Skia's existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent CPU blur selection instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the supporting change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
